comment: The three Feedback knobs are read into a local variable that multiplies lastWet, but lastWet is a by-value parameter of the delay function whose assignment at TriParDel.cpp:174 never reaches the member it was copied from (TriParDel.cpp:122, 196-204). The member stays at its initial zero, so the feedback term is always zero and the knobs change nothing. The maker's own port description says the time jack is 1V per octave when the Time CV trimmer is at 100%, which the code bears out.
